description: Concrete figures from company filings, bank reports, tax returns, government awards and official registers; each value carries the filing it came from and a citable URL. Checks a stated number against the official record. Takes the entity, the metric, the value and the period, and returns match, mismatch or insufficient_evidence together with the registry's own value and its evidence URL. Suited to a generate-verify-revise loop for company, bank, nonprofit or government-spending figures. The three verdicts are distinct: 'mismatch' means the registry disagrees and includes the recorded value; 'insufficient_evidence' means nothing was checked, so it is neither confirmation nor refutation. Where a period is given and no record exists for it, nearby years are returned for context; they are not values for the requested period. The values are public records: facts carry no copyright. US federal records are public domain or CC0; other publishers (e.g. DL-DE-BY-2.0, CC BY 4.0) require naming the source - see usage.attribution per fact. Numbers may be quoted verbatim.

tolerance_percent.description: how close counts as a match; default 1

value.description: the figure you are about to state

name: verify_claim
title: Verify a number
